cases.statement: Two carriers in one family from a cardiac MRI cohort: Proband 1 (male, 20) and his mother Subject 1 (female, 44). Zygosity is not stated. They appear only in Table 1 and the MRI text, with no case narrative.

people.label: Proband 1
people.zygosity_or_genotype: carrier; zygosity not stated (male, X-linked gene)
people.key_phenotypes: HCM phenotype with max LV wall thickness 42 mm; ventricular pre-excitation; syncope; extensive mid-myocardial LGE of the lateral wall with septal sparing; ICD, awaiting heart transplantation

quotes.quote: | Proband 1 | LAMP2 (c.64 + 1G > A) | 20 | M | 18.0 | Palpitation, DOE | II | Yes | NSR; ventricular preexcitation; NSST-T | 59.8 | 50.4 | 42 | 33.4 | Extensive fibrosis mainly in mid-myocardium of lateral wall with septal sparing | 1376.5 | 35.5 | ICD implantation; awaiting heart transplantation |
The proband 1 patient with Danon disease showed a non-typical HCM LGE pattern with extensive fibrosis mainly in the mid-myocardium of the lateral wall with septal sparing (Figure 1)

people.label: Subject 1
people.zygosity_or_genotype: carrier; zygosity not stated (female, X-linked gene)
people.key_phenotypes: LVEF 16.9%; exertional dyspnea and edema; short PR intervals and PVCs; subendocardial and transmural LGE; awaiting heart transplantation

quotes.quote: | Subject 1 | LAMP2 (c.64 + 1G > A) | 44 | F | 23.4 | DOE; edema | II | No | NSR; Short PR intervals; PVC | 16.9 | 27.8 | 16 | 18.9 | Non-ischemic sub-endocardial LGE mainly in lateral wall and transmural LGE pattern | 1581.2 | 43.9 | Heart failure managed; awaiting heart transplantation |
The characteristics of cardiac MRI in the proband 1 patient and the patient’s mother (Subject 1) with Danon disease.
whereas the patient’s mother showed a heterogenous LGE pattern including non-ischemic sub-endocardial LGE, mainly in the lateral wall, and a transmural LGE pattern (Figure 1)

phenotype_specificity.statement: Every subject in the cohort had a 117-gene cardiomyopathy panel plus TTR. The cohort-level text says no GAA or GLA defects were found. Results for other genes in these two people are not reported. The authors take a non-typical LGE pattern with septal sparing in males as a pointer to Danon disease.

quotes.quote: We performed genetic testing in all subjects by next-generation sequencing (NGS) with a panel including 117 cardiomyopathy-related genes [22,23] and TTR gene (Table S1).
Genetic defects causing Pompe’s disease (GAA) and Fabry’s disease (GLA) were not found in this group of patients.
indicates that the “non-typical HCM” LGE pattern with septal sparing in male Danon patients should prompt genetic screening for Danon disease

segregation.statement: The affected mother (Subject 1) carries the variant, as does her affected son (Proband 1). No other relatives of family 1 are reported as tested, and no non-carriers are reported.

quotes.quote: The characteristics of cardiac MRI in the proband 1 patient and the patient’s mother (Subject 1) with Danon disease.

de_novo.statement: Not de novo for Proband 1: his mother carries the variant. Testing of the mother's parents is not reported.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Change at the canonical +1 position of the intron 1 splice donor; the protein effect cannot be predicted from HGVS (p.?). The paper makes no statement on mechanism.

computational_predictions.statement: No prediction is reported for this variant. The methods say only that nonsynonymous changes were filtered with SIFT (cohort-level).

quotes.quote: Nonsynonymous changes were filtered using SIFT software

population_data_in_papers.statement: Nothing is reported for this variant. The methods filter (MAF above 5% removed) applies to the whole cohort.

quotes.quote: Synonymous changes and SNPs that had a minor allele frequency (MAF) higher than 5% were removed

authors_classification.statement: No classification is stated for this variant. A cohort-level rule says a patient was genotype positive only for ACMG class IV or V variants, and the authors count this family among the four LAMP2 cases.

quotes.quote: A patient was considered genotype positive when the mutation was classified to be likely pathogenic or pathogenic (classes IV and V).
seven rare diseases were identified (four cases with LAMP2, one case with PRKAG2, one with TTR mutation, and one case with senile systemic amyloidosis)

concerns: The variant appears only in a cohort table (Table 1) and in MRI descriptions. There is no case narrative, pedigree text or Sanger detail for this person.
Written with spaces ('c.64 + 1G > A'), with no transcript. Reads were aligned to hg19.
Zygosity is not stated for either carrier. The text calls Subject 1 the proband's mother in the figure legend and the MRI results.
The cohort had 34 relatives, but no other relative of family 1 is reported as tested or untested.
notes_for_panel: Mother-son pair, both affected (son with HCM phenotype and pre-excitation; mother with severe LV dysfunction). Evidence is thin on detail: one table row each, and no functional or splice study.
